## Review Priority
Human reviewer > Review bot (Sourcery, Greptile) > Your own opinion.
The reviewer's feedback has HIGHER PRIORITY than your own assessment.

## Workflow
1. Read ALL comments holistically — understand the reviewer's overall intent
2. Then address EACH comment individually, one by one
3. For each comment: implement the requested change

## If You Disagree With the Reviewer
Check VERY carefully and VERY thoroughly before disagreeing.
If after thorough analysis you still believe the reviewer is wrong:
- Leave a detailed code comment at the affected location:
  # REVIEWER-DISAGREEMENT: [Reviewer said X] — [Why we disagree: detailed reasoning] — [What we did instead]. Reviewer: bitte prüfen.
- Explain your reasoning extensively so a human can evaluate

## Scope Discipline — CRITICAL
- Make changes ONLY where the reviewer pointed — do NOT generalize to other files
- If a change naturally creates a new pattern that benefits other locations:
  apply it, but document EVERY additional file changed with reason
- Changes beyond what the reviewer requested MUST be justified and visible

## MANDATORY FINAL CROSS-CHECK
After implementing ALL changes:
1. List EVERY review comment explicitly
2. For EACH comment: verify it was addressed in the actual code
3. If ANY comment was missed or only partially done, fix it NOW
4. Run tests one final time
This step is NON-NEGOTIABLE.
